event: A splashing sound occurs, and its location needs to be determined relative to a hypothetical robot standing by the countertop oven and facing the kitchen hob.

sounding_object.description: Water from a faucet splashing into the kitchen sink. The sink is a white, double-basin, farmhouse-style ceramic sink. The sound is generated by the water hitting the sink and any dishes within it. The sink itself is a static kitchen fixture.

reference_object.description: A silver, box-shaped countertop convection oven/toaster oven located on the kitchen counter.

facing_object.description: A built-in kitchen hob (stovetop) with multiple burners, located on the kitchen counter to the left of the countertop oven.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the countertop oven and facing the kitchen hob, when the splashing sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
